export const T: Strings = { ...en }
let current: Lang = 'en'

export function setLang(lang: Lang): boolean {
  if (lang === current) return false
  current = lang
  Object.assign(T, lang === 'ko' ? ko : en)
  return true
}

export function langSetting(options: Record<string, unknown>): LangSetting {
  return options.language === 'en' || options.language === 'ko' ? options.language : 'auto'
}

// Claude Code /config 의 language 값(자유 글: "Korean", "한국어", "ko" …). 모르면 영어.
export function langFromConfig(value: unknown): Lang {
  return typeof value === 'string' && /korean|한국|^ko(\b|[-_])/i.test(value.trim()) ? 'ko' : 'en'
}

// 범위 이름은 두 언어 모두 받는다(/desk-diff 브랜치 전체 등).
export function allScopeLabels(): Array<[string, string]> {
  return [
    [ko.scopeUncommitted, 'uncommitted'],
    [ko.scopeBranch, 'branch'],
    [ko.scopeCommits, 'commits'],
    [en.scopeUncommitted, 'uncommitted'],
    [en.scopeBranch, 'branch'],
    [en.scopeCommits, 'commits'],
  ]
}
